description: Tool to retrieve data retention configuration for a Google Analytics property. Use when you need to check event-level and user-level data retention durations and reset settings.

inputSchema.description: Request model for retrieving data retention settings for a property.

name.description: Required. The resource name of the data retention settings to retrieve. Must be in the exact format: properties/{property_id}/dataRetentionSettings where property_id is a numeric identifier. IMPORTANT: Must start with 'properties/' prefix, contain no forward slashes in the property_id, have no trailing slashes, and must end with '/dataRetentionSettings'. Valid example: 'properties/489591273/dataRetentionSettings'. Invalid examples: '489591273' (missing prefix), 'properties/489591273' (missing suffix), 'properties/489591273/dataRetentionSettings/' (trailing slash)
name.title: Name

inputSchema.title: GetDataRetentionSettingsRequest

name: get_data_retention_settings

eventDataRetention.description: Duration that event-level data is retained. Possible values: RETENTION_DURATION_UNSPECIFIED, TWO_MONTHS, FOURTEEN_MONTHS, TWENTY_SIX_MONTHS, THIRTY_EIGHT_MONTHS, FIFTY_MONTHS.
eventDataRetention.title: Event Data Retention

name.description: Output only. Resource name for this DataRetentionSettings resource. Format: properties/{property}/dataRetentionSettings.
name.title: Name

resetUserDataOnNewActivity.description: When true, retention period for user identifiers restarts with each new user event.
resetUserDataOnNewActivity.title: Reset User Data On New Activity

userDataRetention.description: Duration that user-level data is retained. Possible values: RETENTION_DURATION_UNSPECIFIED, TWO_MONTHS, FOURTEEN_MONTHS, TWENTY_SIX_MONTHS, THIRTY_EIGHT_MONTHS, FIFTY_MONTHS.
userDataRetention.title: User Data Retention
